name: Exp_BinaryWave_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on the BinaryWave_StDev custom indicator, which combines seven weighted technical indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) into a composite binary wave signal with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, with configurable money management and lot sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BinaryWave_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标将七个加权技术指标（MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI、ADX）组合成复合二元波动信号并进行标准差过滤。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接方向线、禁用）用于入场和出场，并配置了资金管理和手数管理。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是将多个经典技术指标加权组合成一个复合BinaryWave值，然后通过标准差通道进行过滤，产生更可靠的交易信号。入场条件有两种模式：POINT模式检测指标缓冲区中的箭头信号（非EMPTY_VALUE），DIRECT模式检测BinaryWave线的拐点（买入时V形底，卖出时倒V形顶）。出场条件同样支持两种模式：POINT模式检测反向箭头信号，DIRECT模式检测BinaryWave线方向变化（买入仓位于线下降时平仓，卖出仓位于线上升时平仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，配合固定的止损和止盈点数进行风险控制。策略使用可配置的平滑方法对BinaryWave进行二次平滑处理，通过dK1和dK2系数调整标准差通道宽度，减少虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to combine seven classic technical indicators with configurable weights into a composite BinaryWave value, then filter it through standard deviation channels to produce more reliable trading signals. Entry conditions offer two modes: POINT mode detects arrow signals in indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE values), while DIRECT mode detects inflection points on the BinaryWave line (V-bottom for buy, inverted-V-top for sell). Exit conditions also support two modes: POINT mode detects opposite arrow signals, while DIRECT mode detects BinaryWave line direction changes (close long when line declines, close short when line rises). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio, combined with fixed stop loss and take profit in points for risk control. The strategy applies a configurable smoothing method for secondary smoothing of the BinaryWave, adjusting standard deviation channel width via dK1 and dK2 coefficients to reduce false signals.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/扣损后保证金/扣损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosOpen
parameters.description: 买入开仓信号模式（点信号/直接方向/禁用）
parameters.description_en: Buy entry signal mode (dot signal/direct direction/disabled)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 多指标加权组合提高了信号的稳健性，单一指标失效时仍可获得有效信号
标准差通道过滤有效减少了虚假信号，dK1/dK2双系数设计允许灵活调整通道宽度
入场和出场信号模式独立可配置，提供了极高的策略灵活性
多种仓位管理模式适应不同风险偏好的交易者
使用NewBar检测避免同一K线内重复计算和重复开仓
pros_en: Multi-indicator weighted combination improves signal robustness, remaining effective even when individual indicators fail
Standard deviation channel filtering effectively reduces false signals, with dK1/dK2 dual coefficients allowing flexible channel width adjustment
Independent configurable entry and exit signal modes provide extremely high strategy flexibility
Multiple position sizing modes accommodate traders with different risk preferences
NewBar detection prevents redundant calculations and duplicate entries within the same bar
cons: 七个指标全部等权重配置可能不是最优组合，缺乏自适应权重调整机制
止损止盈使用固定点数而非基于ATR的动态设置，在不同波动率环境下效果差异大
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差品种上可能导致不必要的亏损
缺乏对已存在仓位数量的检查，可能在极端情况下过度开仓
依赖外部自定义指标BinaryWave_StDev，指标文件缺失时EA将无法运行
cons_en: Equal weighting for all seven indicators may be suboptimal, lacking an adaptive weight adjustment mechanism
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points rather than ATR-based dynamic levels leads to inconsistent performance across varying volatility environments
No spread filter mechanism, potentially causing unnecessary losses on high-spread instruments
Lacks position count checking, which could lead to over-opening positions in extreme conditions
Depends on the external custom indicator BinaryWave_StDev; EA will fail to run if the indicator file is missing
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，替代固定点数设置
添加点差过滤器，在点差过大时暂停交易以保护资金
实现指标权重的自适应优化或至少提供权重预设方案
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism to replace fixed point settings
Add a spread filter to pause trading when spread is excessively wide, protecting capital
Implement adaptive weight optimization for indicators or at least provide weight presets

risk_points: 固定点数止损止盈在不同波动率市场环境下风险不均衡，低波动时止损可能过宽，高波动时止损可能过窄
没有点差过滤，在流动性差或新闻事件期间可能遭受滑点损失
指标权重需手动优化，错误权重配置可能导致策略失效
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit in points creates unbalanced risk across volatility regimes — too wide in low volatility, too narrow in high volatility
No spread filter may cause slippage losses during low liquidity or news events
Indicator weights require manual optimization; incorrect weight configuration can render the strategy ineffective
